summary: The Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 3 (“Accountability Officers”), requires that the City’s Accountability Officers undergo an annual audit by an external auditor, a practice that began with the Auditor General. As directed by City Council, the City Manager facilitated the request for proposal process and retained Robert Gore and Associates to undertake this work. The external auditors have completed their review. I am transmitting to City Council the external auditor’s reports for the Integrity Commissioner, Lobbyist Registrar and Ombudsman for the year ended December 31, 2017 for information.
decided: City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, deferred Item CC43.1 to the July 23, 24 and 25, 2018 City Council meeting and requested the Integrity Commissioner, the Lobbyist Registrar and the Ombudsman to report directly to Council to provide, if possible, recognizing the duty of confidentiality applicable to accountability officers, any invoices reviewed in the course of the external audit of their offices for the year ended December 31, 2017.

motions.desc: Majority required - CC43.1 - Defer the item
